q1_issues.issue: The sealed content invents the fused symbol coal_power_plant for the elided 'especially coal', a three-word compound no surface run supports.
(Inheritance coal_power_plant power_plant) decomposes to another compound rather than to the single-word head noun 'plant', contrary to 'decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop'.

The bare plural 'older power plants' gets a group witness (GroupOf sk_plant_1 power_plant), where the instruction set reserves group witnesses for definite/demonstrative/counted plurals and the bare class symbol for a non-specific generic.
The comparative content of 'older', 'more power' and 'more cheaply' is dropped entirely (only cheaply survives, as a positive Manner), so three restrictive/graded modifiers leave no trace.

q2_gaps: An attitude NOUN with a that-clause complement in a specificational copular clause ('The N's hope is that P') — Propositional attitudes covers only a verb of thought or speech.

A proper-noun (eponymous) modifier of a common noun ('the Bush administration'): the name rule would mechanically make the administration itself the entity named 'Bush' (cf. 'the Brindle estuary'), and the compound-kind rule bars exposing a noun modifier; neither yields the possessor reading.
An attributive comparative with no stated standard ('older power plants', 'more power', 'more cheaply') — Comparatives & degree only covers an explicit 'than'/'as' standard.

The exemplifying focus particle 'especially', and the dash-set exemplification with an elided head noun ('-- especially coal --'); the focus-particle inventory is only / just / solely, even, also / too / as well, clefts.
notes: The core routing is right: a non-factive attitude with the whole complement sealed under Theme, nothing of P asserted at top level, and the definite 'the efficiency' projected as required; By as a preposition-named oblique for the 'by V-ing' means-phrase is licensed. The main losses are the three unrepresented comparatives and the invented coal_power_plant symbol.
